name: The Second Sun
flavor: It rose where the first one fell.

name: Rift-Bound Heart
flavor: It beats in time with the rift.
text: Every growing upgrade and relic grows twice as fast.

name: The Hollow Throne
text: Take two cards from every after-fight pick.

name: The Hollow Covenant
text: Each hero uses the team's highest HP, ATK, MGK, DEF, CRIT, and attack speed.

name: Snaring Shot
flavor: The arrow holds what it hits.
text: Every 3rd basic attack by a ranged hero Roots its target, never stacking or lengthening a Root.

passives.name: Snaring Shot
passives.text: Every 3rd basic attack Roots its target, if it isn't Rooted already.

name: Chain of Echoes
flavor: Every link rings louder than the last.
text: Every chain the heroes start goes deeper, and each step is stronger than the one before.

name: Crown of the Hollow King
flavor: He gave twice what he was asked. So does his crown.
text: Every keyword heroes apply goes on twice: double stacks, or double duration.

name: Everflame
flavor: It was lit before the rift. It will burn after.
text: Keywords heroes put on enemies never wear off during a fight, and enemies can't remove them.

name: The Unbending
flavor: Bend, and the rift breaks you. Stand.
text: Heroes are immune to every status enemies apply, and each one blocked makes that hero sturdier for the fight.

name: Riftwalker's Soles
flavor: Worn by one who walked the edge and came back.
text: Heroes take no damage from crumbled ground, and enemies on it take a share of their max HP every second.

name: The Long Watch
flavor: The night is long. So is the watch.
text: Fights don't time out at 180s, and from a minute in, every hero grows stronger every few seconds.
